source.citation: Bonanno, Wortman, Lehman, Tweed, Haring, Sonnega, Carr and Nesse (2002), Resilience to loss and chronic grief: a prospective study from preloss to 18-months postloss, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 83(5):1150-1164. Of 205 widowed adults followed at 6 and 18 months: resilient 94 (45.9%), chronic grief 32 (15.6%), common grief 22 (10.7%), chronic depression 16 (7.8%), depressed-improved 21 (10.2%).
